answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to post a reputation bond before earning work. Like yarrow spreading slowly through a field, trust grows only through verified completed jobs, not instant claims. High-value tasks demand a real deposit — saffron-grade work requires a saffron-grade stake — so spawning thousands of fake identities costs real money. A marble ledger records every bond and slash publicly, making reputation non-transferable and forgery economically irrational: attacking the system costs more than honest participation pays.
